name: navidrome-mood
author: 312.dev
description: Labels your library by mood with an LLM and writes real MOOD tags into the files, so smart playlists can filter on feeling. Also keeps natural-language playlists refreshed on a schedule.

http.reason: Send track metadata to the LLM provider you configure, and optionally post progress to a status endpoint you choose. No requiredHosts is declared, so any public host you point it at works while loopback and private addresses stay blocked.

library.reason: Read and write MOOD tags directly in your audio files. Nothing else in the file is modified: audio bytes are never decoded, re-encoded, or moved, and the write is refused if the STREAMINFO checksum block would change.

kvstore.reason: Remember which tracks are already labelled, the free-form descriptors behind each tag, spend so far, and where to resume after a restart. Without it every restart would re-pay for inference already bought.

scheduler.reason: Poll the provider's batch API until results are ready, and refresh prompted playlists on the interval you set.

taskqueue.reason: Run labelling as resumable background work. Each plugin invocation is capped at 30 seconds by Navidrome, so a whole-library pass has to be many small tasks rather than one long one.

subsonicapi.reason: Enumerate tracks to label, read your curated playlists as examples of your own mood vocabulary, and create the playlists you describe.

users.reason: Required by Navidrome in order to call the Subsonic API on behalf of an admin user.

provider.title: LLM provider
provider.description: Anthropic supports batch mode at half price. OpenAI-compatible covers OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Together, DeepSeek and anything else exposing that API shape.

model.title: Model
model.description: Leave blank for the provider's sensible default.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Only for OpenAI-compatible providers, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

batchMode.title: Use batch API where available
batchMode.description: Roughly half the cost, but results arrive over minutes to hours rather than immediately.

maxSpendUsd.title: Spend limit (USD)
maxSpendUsd.description: Hard cap. Real usage is tracked from each response and labelling stops when the cap is reached, so this is a guarantee rather than an estimate.

skipTagged.title: Skip tracks that already have a MOOD tag
skipTagged.description: Leaves tags written by Picard, beets or anything else alone. Turn off to relabel everything.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Label and report, but never write to a file. Recommended for the first pass.

statusToken.title: Status token
statusToken.description: Optional. Generate one at the plugin website to watch progress in a browser. Leave blank and the plugin sends nothing at all.

relayUrl.title: Status endpoint
relayUrl.description: Override where status is posted. Point it at your own relay, an ntfy topic, or any webhook.

sendTrackTitles.title: Include track titles in status updates
sendTrackTitles.description: Off by default, so only counts and cost leave your server.

playlists.title: Prompted playlists
playlists.description: Describe a playlist in plain language and it is kept refreshed. The model writes smart-playlist rules, so between refreshes Navidrome re-evaluates them continuously at no cost.

prompt.title: Describe it
examples: rainy sunday morning, reflective but not sad
loud 90s guitars I haven't played in a year

vocabulary.title: Mood vocabulary override
vocabulary.description: Comma-separated. Leave blank to use the built-in set. Terms may not themselves contain a comma, semicolon or slash, because Navidrome splits tag values on those.

selfTest.title: Self test
selfTest.description: Diagnostic. "read" opens one FLAC through the library mount and reports its structure without writing. "write" additionally writes a marker tag, reads it back, then removes it and verifies the removal. Run this once after granting write access, before any real labelling.
